== Summary ==
[[1998 Decipher World Championship]], Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia, 20–22 November 1998. Scrapbook page: the game room, with the ocean view to the left and score boards and two iMacs for internet access (handwritten captions). From the Hunter family photo album.

== Source ==
Photographed album page posted by [[Hayes Hunter]] in the Players Committee Slack, 7 April 2020 ("My mom is downsizing. Pictures (and captions) from Worlds 1998 and MA states 2000"): https://starwarsccg.slack.com/archives/C4BHV1KTK/p1586279248461000

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-5/54/1998_World_Championship_game_room_scrapbook_page.jpg Internet Archive item].
